criteria.why: Whole tree is passed as Scaffold's non-existent `body` prop, so the Scaffold has no body and the title never renders.
Group headings and white rounded cards live inside the ignored `body` prop, so nothing is shown.
Toggle rows (correctly built with Expanded label + Switch and separate signals) are inside the ignored `body` prop and never render.
Slider and rounded value label are inside the ignored `body` prop and never render.
Dark mode row is inside the ignored `body` prop and never renders.
The SingleChildScrollView is inside the ignored `body` prop, so there is no content and nothing scrolls.

runtime.why: No exception: the Scaffold just renders an empty #F2F2F7 background because `body` is not a prop.

1-settings-1.tsx.notes: Content is given via `body={...}` instead of JSX children, so the screen is blank; the tree itself would have satisfied every criterion had it been passed as children.
